checkpoint.name: Alpha 2.0 - Skill tree rework, automation quests, visual punch correction
checkpoint.summary: Added automation progression quests and stats, rebuilt the skill tree as a hidden central-root compass tree, polished shared UI, committed/pushed/deployed that checkpoint, then made an uncommitted correction to restore faster pacing and stronger visual impact.

latestCommittedGameCommit.message: Rework skill tree progression and polish UI

currentUncommittedWork.summary: Follow-up tuning after user feedback that the game was nerfed too hard: speed early progression back up and make the skill tree more visually striking.

filesChanged.purpose: Reduced global skill cost pacing multiplier/level step and lowered lifetime-touch gates for early and mid skill unlocks.
Moved field expansion milestones earlier and increased tile rewards so the board grows faster and looks busier sooner.
Increased skill tree visual punch: brighter labels, stronger node glow, thicker brighter branch lines, more visible dormant buds, and a golden flash on skill reveal.

deployment.note: The latest live domain currently reflects commit bc3508f. The follow-up pacing/visual punch correction is local only and still needs commit/push/deploy if approved.

implementedSincePreviousHandoff: Added AutomationProgressSystem and save version 8 automationStats for automated actions, automated Grass Touches, automation supply drops, and used directives.
Recorded automation stats from sprinkler and companion action paths without adding broad scans or offline progress.
Added 8 Automation quests and an Auto Quest Log filter.
Reworked skill tree layout from left-to-right into a central Softer Grass root with north/south/east/west branch paths.
Made unrevealed skill nodes hidden until their prerequisite path is opened.
Added dormant path hints so hidden branches are teased without exposing the full tree.
Added skill node click shake, reveal sprout animation, unlock sound cue, and reveal message.
Tuned early skill costs once, then after user feedback tuned pacing faster again locally.
Polished shared text buttons, HUD title/resource text, combo badge, modal titles, and skill tree node/readout contrast.
Committed/pushed/deployed the main automation/skill/UI checkpoint as bc3508f.
